t: Streamlining Image Workflow for Jekyll Sites in Linux GNOME
s: This article details a practical workflow for integrating screenshots into Jekyll websites on Linux GNOME, focusing on efficient asset management and maintaining creative momentum. It outlines a step-by-step process from screenshot capture to Markdown embedding.
sub: Screenshot capture and organization in Linux GNOME (/home/mike/Pictures/Screenshots)
Local Jekyll preview image asset management (/home/mike/repos/MikeLev.in/images)
Renaming screenshots for SEO/clarity (e.g., 'Screenshot From YYYY-MM-DD HH-MM-SS.png' to 'descriptive-name.png')
Markdown tag construction for image embedding: `![Alt Text](/images/image-name.png)`
